texto:
More and more people in big cities are starting their own small gardens. This trend is called urban gardening, and it is becoming very popular. Because many city residents live in apartments, they don't have big yards. Instead, they use small spaces like balconies, windowsills, and even rooftops to grow plants. They often plant vegetables like tomatoes and lettuce, herbs such as basil and mint, and beautiful flowers.

There are many good reasons for this. First, it allows people to have fresh, healthy food that they grew themselves. This food often tastes better than what you can buy in a supermarket. Second, gardening is a relaxing activity that can reduce stress. People enjoy taking care of their plants and watching them grow. Finally, it can build community. Neighbors often share tips and extra vegetables, which creates a nice community feeling and helps people connect. Urban gardening shows that you don't need a lot of space to connect with nature.

preguntas.pregunta: According to the text, where do people in cities practice urban gardening?

opciones.A: In large farms outside the city
opciones.C: In small spaces like balconies and rooftops
opciones.D: Inside their kitchens and living rooms

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C porque el texto dice explícitamente: 'they use small spaces like balconies, windowsills, and even rooftops to grow plants'. The text directly lists these places as examples of where urban gardening happens. Las otras opciones son incorrectas. La opción A (large farms) es lo opuesto a la jardinería urbana. La opción B (only in community gardens) es limitante, ya que el texto menciona espacios personales. Las opciones D y E no se mencionan como los lugares principales en el texto.

preguntas.pregunta: What can we infer about the people who practice urban gardening?

opciones.B: They do not like to buy food from supermarkets
opciones.C: They care about eating healthy food and building community
opciones.D: They have a lot of free time
opciones.E: They find gardening very difficult and stressful

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C. El texto no lo dice directamente, pero podemos inferirlo a partir de los beneficios que menciona. El texto dice que la jardinería 'allows people to have fresh, healthy food' y que 'it can build community'. This implies that these benefits are important to the people doing it. Las otras opciones no se pueden deducir. La A es incorrecta, ya que son 'city residents', no profesionales. La B es una suposición demasiado fuerte. El texto no dice nada sobre tener mucho tiempo libre (D) o que sea estresante (E); al contrario, dice que es una 'relaxing activity'.
